# Resurrectio — From Incarceration to Restoration

> Resurrectio is a reentry platform for prison ministries and organizations serving returning citizens. Built on the CROS ecosystem and powered by Narrative Relational Intelligence (NRI), it tracks people on journeys — not cases in pipelines.

Resurrectio replaces spreadsheets, fragmented case management tools, and double-entry government reporting with a unified platform designed from the ground up for the reentry mission.

## What Resurrectio Does

Resurrectio helps reentry organizations:
- Track returning citizens through restoration stages (Pre-Release → Stabilization → Growth → Flourishing → Alumni)
- Coordinate housing, employment, compliance, and programs in one place
- Match and manage mentors with returning citizens
- Detect drift risk, transformation momentum, and 17 other NRI signal types
- Generate government compliance exports (WIPS/PIRL, HMIS, SPARS, OJP PMT, Workforce One)
- Build AI-powered resumes for returning citizens in 5 minutes
- Coordinate transportation, emergency funds, and document recovery
- Track family wellbeing — children's school status, communication facilitation, reunification preparation
- Detect staff burnout before good people leave the mission
- Generate funder-ready impact dashboards with no individual names

## Key Differentiators

1. **People, Not Cases** — Every person has a story unfolding toward flourishing, not a case number in a compliance pipeline
2. **NRI Intelligence** — 19 signal types purpose-built for reentry, including substance relapse risk, mental health crisis, parole violation risk, and re-incarceration risk composite score. NRI suggests — it never acts autonomously.
3. **The Full Rising Arc** — Part of the CROS ecosystem connecting Fabrica (guild training), Communis (worker cooperatives), Propria (community land trusts), and CROS (civic participation). No other platform connects incarceration to ownership.
4. **Government Reporting** — One-click exports for WIPS/PIRL, HMIS, SPARS, OJP PMT, Workforce One, and state DOC systems. Click-to-copy worksheets for manual-entry portals.
5. **30+ Integrations** — Migrate from Salesforce, HubSpot, Blackbaud, Bonterra Apricot, CiviCRM, and 15+ other platforms
6. **Gmail Intelligence** — NRI watches your sent folder for contacts to add, commitments to track, and follow-ups to surface
7. **Everyone Gets Everything** — No paywalled features. Every plan includes NRI, email campaigns, storytelling, reporting. Tiers are about team size, not feature access.

## Pricing

- Seedling ($29/mo) — Up to 5 active staff & mentors
- Growing ($79/mo) — Up to 25 active staff & mentors
- Coalition ($149/mo) — Unlimited staff & mentors
- Returning citizens, volunteers, and imported contacts are always free and unlimited

## Regulatory Compliance

- 42 CFR Part 2 (substance use disorder records)
- CJIS Security Policy (criminal justice data)
- HIPAA (with BAA available)
- SOC 2 Type II (in progress)
- CCPA, VCDPA, CPA (state privacy laws)

## Built For

Prison Fellowship, Kairos Prison Ministry, Catholic Charities Reentry, Diocesan Prison Ministries, Dismas Ministry, St. Vincent de Paul, Catholic Mobilizing Network, Fortune Society, Center for Employment Opportunities, Second Chance Act Grantees, CCHD Grantees, and any organization serving returning citizens.

## The CROS Ecosystem

Resurrectio is one app in the CROS family. Each app shares the same architecture, calm UX, and conviction that people are not transactions:
- **Fabrica** — Guild & makerspace management, 16-week reentry course, companion book for incarcerated people
- **Communis** — Worker cooperative management, employment to ownership
- **Propria** — Community Land Trust management, permanent affordable housing
- **CROS** — The core Communal Relationship OS for community organizing

## Technical Stack

React 18 + TypeScript, Vite, Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), React Router, Radix UI / shadcn, TailwindCSS, TanStack React Query, Lucide icons
